programs.title: Premier League Goals of the Season
programs.description: A look back at the best goals from the 2005/06 season. Thierry Henry became the first player in the league's history to win the Golden Boot four times, top-scoring with 27 goals.

programs.title: Premier League Goals of the Season
programs.description: A look back at the best goals from the 2006/07 season. Chelsea's Didier Drogba topped the scoring charts with 20 goals, ahead of Benni McCarthy (18) and Cristiano Ronaldo (17).

programs.title: Premier League Goals of the Season
programs.description: A look back at the best goals from the 2007/08 season. Cristiano Ronaldo topped the scoring charts with a remarkable 31 goals, ahead of Fernando Torres and Emmanuel Adebayor on 24.

programs.title: Premier League Goals of the Season
programs.description: A look back at the best goals from the 2008/09 season. Chelsea striker Nicolas Anelka secured the Golden Boot with 19 goals, beating Cristiano Ronaldo to the prize.

programs.title: Premier League Goals of the Season
programs.description: We revisit the best goals from the 2009/2010 season. In his most prolific season for Chelsea, Didier Drogba secured the Golden Boot with 29 goals, three ahead of Wayne Rooney.

programs.title: Premier League Goals of the Season
programs.description: A look back at the best goals from the 2010/2011 season. Dimitar Berbatov and Carlos Tevez shared the Golden Boot with 20 goals, ahead of Robin van Persie who finished with 18.

programs.title: Premier League Goals of the Season
programs.description: A look back at the best goals from the 2011/12 season. With 30 goals, Robin van Persie won the Golden Boot in his final season for Arsenal, finishing three ahead of Wayne Rooney.

programs.title: Prem Classics
programs.subtitle: 2012/13: Season Review
programs.description: A review of the 2012/13 season. Sir Alex Ferguson ended his managerial career as Manchester United clinched their 13th Premier League title and FA Cup winners Wigan were relegated.

programs.title: Prem Classics
programs.subtitle: 2013/14: Season Review
programs.description: A review of the 2013/14 season. Manchester City clinched their second Premier League title, José Mourinho returned to Chelsea and Tony Pulis masterminded a great escape at Palace.

programs.title: Prem Classics
programs.subtitle: 2014/15: Season Review
programs.description: A review of the 2014/15 season. Eden Hazard's superb form helped Chelsea clinch their fifth title, while newly-promoted Burnley and QPR made immediate returns to the Championship.

programs.title: Prem Classics
programs.subtitle: 2015/16: Season Review
programs.description: A review of the 2015/16 season. Leicester City shocked the footballing world, José Mourinho's second tenure at Chelsea came to an end and Newcastle dropped into the second tier.

programs.title: Premier League Goals of the Season
programs.description: A look back at the best goals from the 2016/17 season. Harry Kane won the Golden Boot for the second successive season with 29 goals, scoring seven goals in Spurs' last two games.

programs.title: Premier League Goals of the Season
programs.description: A look back at the best goals from the 2017/18 season. Liverpool's Mohamed Salah held off Harry Kane to clinch the Golden Boot, as both players reached 30 goals.

programs.title: Premier League Goals of the Season
programs.description: Revisit the best goals from the 2018/19 season. Three players shared the Golden Boot after Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang equalled Liverpool duo Mo Salah and Sadio Mané as top scorers.

programs.title: Premier League Goals of the Season
programs.description: Revisit the best goals from the 2019/20 Premier League season, featuring brilliant finishes by Son Heung-min, Jamie Vardy, Kevin De Bruyne, and other stars.

programs.title: Premier League Goals of the Season
programs.description: A look back at the best goals from the 2020/21 season. With 22 goals, Harry Kane pipped Mohammed Salah to the Golden Boot.

programs.title: Premier League Goals of the Season
programs.description: A look back at the best goals from the 2021/22 season. Mohammed Salah and Son Heung-min shared the Golden Boot this season with 23 goals each.

programs.title: Premier League Goals of the Season
programs.description: A look back at the best goals of the 2022/23 Premier League season, featuring stunning strikes from Julio Enciso, Mo Salah, and Martin Odegaard.
